title: Bakery Session
intro: Bakery Session lets attraction become unusually gentle before suspicion returns. The speaker is hesitant; the figure in the window notices him, initiates contact and asks him not to rush. Sweetness is therefore something offered rather than seized. But he still wants to know the flavour in advance, and perfection itself becomes evidence that something must go wrong. No actual disaster occurs in the lyric. It circles back to the first sighting, preserving both the tenderness of the encounter and the fear that prevents fully trusting it.
reading: Reciprocal, patient desire interrupted by anticipatory mistrust; the feared accident never occurs in the narrated scene.

revisions.25-n1: The initial 'like' permits a comparison between a desired person and a pastry; the seed eyes and wheat smell then make the pastry almost literal. Later it looks back and touches him. Keeping that border mobile matters because the encounter changes from looking at an attractive object to receiving an initiative from another presence. An annotation that chooses only a human love interest or only an animated snack would flatten the fantasy's movement.
revisions.editorial-25-icing-contact: He cannot bring himself to approach, so the other figure starts the contact. The icing on the nose is playful, followed by reassurance and permission not to rush. The scene's intimacy comes from being met in his hesitation rather than forced out of it. Across an album full of unwanted scrutiny and demands, this is a markedly different way for somebody else's attention to feel.
revisions.25-n2: The taste question tries to know in advance what getting close will feel like. Sweet and sour remain bodily flavours, but they also name the mixtape's closing and opening tracks. Here the opposition is not settled by choosing one. The repeated uncertainty becomes a small version of the encounter's larger problem: desire can bring him close enough to imagine the taste without making the outcome safe to predict.
revisions.25-n3: The familiar 'barring surprises' formula turns into a prediction that a surprise is due. Perfection is treated as grounds for distrust. But the song does not then show a betrayal or mishap; it returns to the sunny walk and the moment of seeing the figure. That distinction matters. We hear the expectation of disappointment interrupt happiness, not evidence that the happiness was false.
